10277|a14963d0.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|a14963d0.text: Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1294|fe52f4ea.name: Aldric Moore
1294|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1297|ed056522.name: Lina Stover
1297|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1298|ed056522.name: Frederick Stover
1298|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1299|ed056522.name: Lisbeth Schneider
1299|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1309|23d8b931.name: Wynne Larson
1309|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1310|0624ab70.name: Evan Larson
1310|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

16418|a6b84e2b.name: Mupsi Shacklefridd
16418|a6b84e2b.text: You'd better not be causing trouble, $N!

16458|41276936.name: Innkeeper Faralia
16458|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

2327|33af2c00.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3181|a28d29e1.name: Fremal Doohickey
3181|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5492|837f02f9.name: Katherine the Pure
5492|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5595|46dd318e.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|46dd318e.text:
Do we have Mining trainers here?  Where do ye think ye are!?  

Why you'll find one o' the best miners in all Dun Morogh at the Deepmountain Mining Guild on the northern side of The Great Forge.  There, Geofram Bouldertoe will show ye the true art of mining.

5595|632a21ad.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|632a21ad.text: Well well!  You've come to the right place to learn Mining, boyo!  Geofram Bouldertoe himself resides at the Deepmountain Mining Guild.  Ye couldn't ask for a better instructor than him.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

8496|944c29ff.name: Liv Rizzlefix
8496|944c29ff.text:
Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.

You've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...

Tanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?

<Liv shakes her head.>

No, that's not it...

9099|738476a6.name: Sraaz
9099|738476a6.text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.

925|837f02f9.name: Brother Sammuel
925|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

1057-accept.name: Keeper Albagorm
1057-accept.text:
As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.

You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.

The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.

Drive the wretched harpies out, $N!
1057-accept.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

15-complete.name: Marshal McBride
15-complete.text: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
15-complete.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

21-accept.name: Marshal McBride
21-accept.text:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, $N.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21-accept.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

3101-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3101-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Brother Sammuel, our local $c trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3101-accept.title: Consecrated Letter

3101-complete.name: Brother Sammuel
3101-complete.text:
In the meantime, you should know one or two other things. You are a symbol to many here in this land--act accordingly. The Holy Light shines within you, and it will be obvious to both your allies and your enemies.

Also, as you gain in wisdom and power, you will need to train to learn new abilities. That's where I come in. When you feel you've gained some experience here in Northshire, come back to me and I will teach you what I feel you are ready to learn. Good luck... $c!
3101-complete.title: Consecrated Letter

3101-progress.name: Brother Sammuel
3101-progress.text: Finally! We meet face to face, brother to brother. I welcome you to Northshire. This will be your home for a short time while you learn the ins and outs of how things are done, but know that Stormwind is not far off, and sooner or later, your path will take you there. But until then, be patient... Knight of the Silver Hand.
3101-progress.title: Consecrated Letter

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

333-accept.name: Harlan Bagley
333-accept.text:
We've been doing a lot of business lately.  It seems like everyone is buying armor and sturdy clothes.  Almost like they expect a cold, harsh season ahead...

But those are future worries.  My worry today is that I'm running out of knitted clothing to sell.  I need another load from our supplier.

If you can take this request to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, I'd be most grateful.
333-accept.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply

333-complete.name: Rema Schneider
333-complete.text:
It says here that Harlan's business is booming.  That's good news, but I wonder why people have need of all that armor.  I've heard nothing of open war...is there something the nobles aren't telling us?

Well, thank you for bringing the request.  Here's your payment, and I'll see to it that Harlan gets his supplies.
333-complete.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply

333-progress.name: Rema Schneider
333-progress.text: You bring word from Mr. Bagley?
333-progress.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply

334-accept.name: Rema Schneider
334-accept.text:
My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great $C like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

Please, $N.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
334-accept.title: Package for Thurman

334-complete.name: Thurman Schneider
334-complete.text:
Oh, blast!  I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work.  Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...

Oh, well.  Fun will come later I guess.
334-complete.title: Package for Thurman

334-progress.name: Thurman Schneider
334-progress.text: Are you here to buy clothes?
334-progress.title: Package for Thurman

343-accept.name: Brother Kristoff
343-accept.text:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
343-accept.title: Speaking of Fortitude

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

79008-complete.name: Unknown
79008-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79008-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

79192-complete.name: Unknown
79192-complete.text: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
79192-complete.title: Stepping Stones

79974-accept.name: Unknown
79974-accept.text:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974-accept.title: Wet Job

79975-accept.name: Unknown
79975-accept.text:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975-accept.title: Eagle's Fist

79975-complete.name: Unknown
79975-complete.text: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.
79975-complete.title: Eagle's Fist

79976-accept.name: Unknown
79976-accept.text:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976-accept.title: This Must Be The Place

79976-complete.name: Unknown
79976-complete.text: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.
79976-complete.title: This Must Be The Place

79980-accept.name: Unknown
79980-accept.text: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980-accept.title: Scramble

79980-complete.name: Unknown
79980-complete.text: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.
79980-complete.title: Scramble

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91743-complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743-complete.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91904-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91904-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91904-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-progress.name: Tomas
96626-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96626-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96627-complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627-complete.title: The Adventurer

97916-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97916-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97916-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label
